CLOCK_FONTS_DESCRIPTION: Enable the fonts used by the random clock. Keep at least one enabled. Use the preview button or each font's help icon to see 12:34.
AT_LEAST_ONE_FONT: Keep at least one clock font enabled.
IDLE_DELAY_SECONDS_DOC: Delay in seconds after playback stops. Default: 300 seconds.
DISPLAY_ROTATION_DOC: Rotation for the ST7789 display. Default: 90.
